issues.title: India's inflation watch sharpens as oil and currency risks meet the weekend
issues.summary: The government's monthly economic review flags weather and supply-side inflation risks while domestic demand and industrial activity support growth. Friday's market close, the rupee and oil prices frame the weekend; OPEC+ meets Sunday and MoSPI's IIP and GDP releases are due Monday.

issues.title: Markets retreat as oil and rupee pressure return; RBI adjusts liquidity rules
issues.summary: Nifty and Sensex retreat as IT, auto and financial shares come under pressure. The rupee weakens to ₹92.99 per dollar, Brent rises above $96.50, and the RBI reduces daily minimum CRR maintenance from 99% to 90% from 1 December.

issues.title: IT-led gains lift Dalal Street as oil and rupee volatility return
issues.summary: Nifty and Sensex extend gains as IT and realty lead; the RBI allots ₹1,20,738 crore across two overnight VRR operations. The rupee weakens with higher oil, US growth and core inflation remain firm, and India's next IIP and GDP releases approach.

issues.title: Dalal Street rebounds sharply, but the global risk-off signal has not cleared
issues.summary: The Sensex gains 1.82% and the Nifty 50 rises 1.85% as the rupee reaches an eight-month high. The RBI completes two overnight liquidity operations, while tariff uncertainty and AI-related selling keep global risk appetite fragile.

issues.title: A holiday pause on Dalal Street; RBI's next liquidity move and a global AI rebound in focus
issues.summary: Indian cash markets close for Guru Nanak Jayanti as the RBI retains three D-SIBs and schedules fresh liquidity and bond operations. Asian equities rebound, while later US futures and European trading show the AI rally losing momentum.

issues.title: A sharp market reversal, but India's activity pulse stays expansionary
issues.summary: Sensex and Nifty fall after a four-week rally as banks and metals lead losses. November flash PMI remains expansionary, the RBI conducts two VRR auctions and the rupee weakens.

issues.title: India's rally meets a global risk reset
issues.summary: Sunday market brief: Friday's Indian rebound and rupee strength meet a global technology-led correction, renewed Middle East risk and a shortened week ahead.

issues.title: Indian equities defy the global sell-off as banks lead the Friday rebound
issues.summary: Weekend edition: Friday's domestic recovery, a stronger rupee and a fourth weekly gain contrasted with a technology-led global sell-off.
